look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson eleven
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 3, lesson T11, spot vs futures; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: Two traders
scenes.desc: Asha buys 0.010 BTC on spot; Rahul opens a long futures position of the same size; both gain when BTC rises.

scenes.name: Spot: you own it
scenes.desc: Spot defined; gold-coin analogy; Asha pays 600 USDT and 0.010 BTC lands in her wallet.

scenes.name: Futures: a contract
scenes.desc: Futures contract and underlying defined; Rahul opens a long contract and no BTC arrives in his wallet.

scenes.name: Perpetual
scenes.desc: Dated futures expire on a date; a perpetual has no end date; on close, profit or loss is settled in USDT.

scenes.name: Exposure
scenes.desc: Exposure and notional value: 0.010 BTC x 60,000 = 600 USDT for both traders.

scenes.name: Side by side
scenes.desc: The same price path for both: 63,000 gives 630 USDT / +30 USDT; 57,000 gives 570 USDT / -30 USDT.

scenes.name: Going short
scenes.desc: A short futures position gains when price falls: +30 at 57,000, -30 at 63,000; plain spot can only sell coins you hold.

scenes.name: No coin to withdraw
scenes.desc: Common mistake: a futures position is not owned BTC; a withdraw attempt shows 0 BTC.

scenes.name: Extra futures risks
scenes.desc: Leverage (T12), liquidation as a conceptual shrinking margin, and a funding clock.

scenes.name: Sort them
scenes.desc: Pause and sort five examples into spot or futures; countdown, then each card moves to its bin.

scenes.name: The whole picture
scenes.desc: Comparison table: what you hold, what you pay, short, expiry, funding, liquidation.

scenes.name: Know the risks
scenes.desc: Neither is safe; futures can lose faster and be closed for you; costs add up; WAIT / NO_TRADE.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question to check yourself.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T12, margin and leverage.
